properties.label_detail_en: Find-spot of Kashta's stele, not a border; c.−750 "the Nubians occupied at least part of Upper Egypt" (GHA II ch.10 p.280). −800 to −713: no extent sourced.
properties.label_detail_ar: موقع العثور على لوحة كاشتا، وليس حداً؛ نحو −750 «احتل النوبيون جزءاً على الأقل من مصر العليا» (تاريخ أفريقيا العام II، الفصل 10 ص280). −800 إلى −713: لا امتداد موثق. [Arabic text pending native-speaker review.]

notes: −800 to −713: no extent (only the Elephantine find-spot). −656 to −593: no filled area; Lower Nubia "a kind of no man's land", disputed with Egypt (GHA II pp.283–284), depopulated (p.306); southern limits unknown. No sourced place named, so no point. Polygons −713/−656 and −593/−270 withdrawn (rested on SFDAS_HCS2017, not accepted); replaced by the Napata capital marker (GHA2_CH10 p.283, role ends −300). No area drawn.
